command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true >/dev/null; sleep 8; echo '=== nested-cause probe ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge.*(shizuku_probe_result|probe=|error=|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|offcall_parity_ok|service_uid=|service_pid=)' | tail -n 100 || true; echo '=== call_media exceptions ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v threadtime | grep -Ei 'aicallbridge:call_media|InvocationTargetException|IllegalStateException|SecurityException|NoSuchMethodException|NameNotFoundException|UnsupportedOperationException|AudioRecord|AudioFlinger|invalid attr' | tail -n 220 || true; echo phase2c_nested_cause_probe_complete=true
